hints.title: Monotonic Feasibility
hints.text: If time t is sufficient to eat all grains, any time greater than t is also sufficient.

hints.title: Ordered Greedy Matching
hints.text: Sort hens and grains. Each hen should greedily consume the earliest available uneaten grains.

hints.title: Two-Way Path Reach Calculation
hints.text: If a hen at h must reach a leftmost grain at g <= h with distance d = h - g, the farthest right grain it can reach within time t is max(h + (t - 2 * d), h + (t - d) // 2).

hints.title: Binary Search Grain Consumption Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n + m log m); feasibility check takes O(n + m) across logarithmic search steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Assigning grains to hens without monotonicity yields exponential permutations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines binary search on time with greedy reach path formulas.
